scope: Canonical public Admin APIs with real OTP/TOTP and owned disposable QA records. Existing customer accounts, published models and balances are not modified.

checks.name: administrator signs in with fresh real OTP/TOTP and highest-admin authority
existing unused model contains its own endpoint and a masked configured key
existing model endpoint and API key can be edited through a new revision of the same model
model deletion requires its exact confirmation and leaves the published real text model available
admin can grant and revoke an actual manual VIP entitlement while preserving both history revisions
bulk workspace deletion fences the exact two owned workspaces and creates durable cleanup jobs
bulk user deletion removes contact identity after preserving the referenced billing, VIP and operation history
